violations.reason: At step 18 the agent called modify_pending_order_items, and at step 21 the resulting order status was 'pending (item modified)'. The policy says that after this item modification action the agent will not be able to modify the order anymore, but the agent then called modify_pending_order_address at step 19, and at step 22 the shipping address was changed. This is an order modification performed after the item-modification action that the policy states leaves the order unable to be modified further.
